title: Sweetwater Grade 1 lesson plan, week of Nov 2 (re-read Nov 1)
scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[Week 11.2-11.6 | Foundations 11/2, Wednesday (session 27)-Cumulative Review] Read and write words with -sh, -th, -ch, wh, -sh, -ck - Read and understand words with 's … Tell who or what owns the item.
[Week 11.2-11.6 | Foundations 11/2, Thursday (session 28)-Cumulative Review] Red and write words that have words with ch, ng, and tch. - Read and write words that end in -s and -es.
[Week 11.2-11.6 | Foundations 11/2, Friday Session 29] Read and write words that have bl, cl, fl, pl at the beginning. - Read and write words that end in ed and ing.
[Week 11.2-11.6 | Foundations 11/2, Friday Session 30] Read and write words that have st, sk, sm, sp at the beginning of a word. - Read compound words
[Week 11.2-11.6 | Foundations 11/2, Friday Session 30, Instructions] Remind students that compound words are when two small words come together to make one word. Ex: butter+fly=butterfly.
[Week 11.2-11.6 | Foundations 11/2, Vocabulary row] Superwords: like, make, there, what; go, no, so, which, from, have, look, or,about, out, play, were; by, come, my, some
[Week 11.2-11.6 | M 11/2, Wednesday- Session 3] Today I will use doubles plus 1 or minus 1 to solve near doubles problems.
[Week 11.2-11.6 | M 11/2, Wednesday- Session 3, CER Exit Ticket] How can you use doubles to solve 7 + 6?
[Week 11.2-11.6 | M 11/2, Friday- Session 5, CER Exit Ticket] Boom uses 8 + 8 + 1 and Buzz uses 9 + 9 − 1 to solve 8 + 9.
[Week 11.2-11.6 | Science 11/2, Unit 4: Weather and seasons] S1E1.a Represent data in tables and/or graphs to identify and describe different types of weather
[Week 11.2-11.6 | Science 11/2, Success criteria] Record my weather symbol in a chart/graph.
